biggest_catch: The extra $100 only lands if your friend keeps an ACTIVE Simply Checking account for 6 months: S1 savings with $5+, recurring monthly direct deposit of $500+, eStatements, monthly eBanking/mBanking use, and 15+ debit card purchases per month. Otherwise you earn just the initial $25.
catches: You must be a St. Paul Federal Credit Union member to refer; the friend must name you as their referrer at account opening.
Friend must open at least an S1 Savings account ($5 minimum) and an S10 Simply Checking account ($50 minimum) within 60 days of the referral.
Initial $25 cash reward credited to both S1 Savings accounts within 30 days of account opening (accounts must be open).

Additional $100 each only if the friend's account is 'Active' after 6 months: S1 savings with $5+ balance, recurring monthly direct deposit of at least $500, eStatements enrolled, eBanking/mBanking used at least once per month, debit card used 15+ times per month.
Referred friend must be at least 18; all regular account opening procedures and membership eligibility apply.
Referral bonus funds reported as dividends on IRS Form 1099-INT; you are responsible for taxes.
No limit on the number of referrals per calendar year; offer may be cancelled at any time without notice.

steps: Fill in the referral form on stpaulfcu.org with your friend's information and submit.
Friend opens an S1 Savings account and an S10 Simply Checking account within 60 days, naming you as their referrer.
You receive a $25 cash reward credited to your S1 Savings within 30 days of the account opening.
If the friend's account meets the active-account criteria after 6 months, you receive an additional $100 cash reward.
timing: Initial $25 within 30 days of account opening; additional $100 after 6 months if the friend's account is active; both require open accounts.
when_cash_arrives: First $25 lands within 30 days of account opening; the extra $100 only after 6 months of sustained activity.
maximize: Take the fast $25: it pays within 30 days of opening; the extra $100 needs 6 months of recurring $500+ direct deposits, 15+ debit purchases/month, and active eBanking - do not plan on it.
Refer people who will keep the account active anyway; you cannot manufacture 6 months of activity.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the big tier is a 6-month loyalty holdout - only the base $25 is fast money.
